Phasmos

ClientUniversità degli studi Mediterranea di Reggio Calabria RoleProduct Design Year2024
Explore the details

A work table that changes posture — named after the stick insect, an organism that survives by adapting its form without changing what it fundamentally is.

The table

Each leg mounts on its own ball-and-socket joint, rotating independently to any angle. The same six legs reconfigure into three postures — nothing swapped, nothing added.

Three postures

Each takes its name from a stick-insect behaviour, and each answers a specific use rather than a visual preference.

Riposo — working height
Estesa — raised, compact
Mimesi — tilted toward the user
